Reference / http/version

http/version#

HTTP versions, and the HTTP/1.x text of HTTP/1 message lines.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Http1VersionText(HttpVersion.http_1_1).string();         // "HTTP/1.1"
ParsedHttp1Version("HTTP/1.0").version();                // HttpVersion.http_1_0

Description#

HTTP versions, and the HTTP/1.x text of HTTP/1 message lines.

HTTP/2 has no such text; which protocol a connection speaks is chosen by ALPN or by configuration.

Public API#

enum HttpVersion#

enum HttpVersion = (http_1_0, http_1_1, http_2)

Message identities and the exact HTTP/1 textual token grammar. ALPN selection and consuming connection policy belong to a later verified transport slice.
